evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Retrieval-augmented multi-hop question answering (QA) decomposes a query into sub-questions and decomposes the corpus into smaller retrieval units such as sentences.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: DER-RAG needs no graph construction, no corpus modification, and no fine-tuning, yet on three multi-hop QA benchmarks it matches or exceeds strong baselines, including graph-based methods that depend on costly offline structures.
